The '''Mission to Saffalore''' was a [[Wraith Squadron]] mission in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] to infiltrate [[Binring Biomedical Product]] and gain intelligence about its connection with [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]. [[Brevet]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Garik Loran]] led Wraith Squadron, while [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] provided air support. Scientist [[Edda Gast]] was captured as a result of this mission.
